label: SPATIOTEMPORAL_2: Located F x:= ∃ r, F.locatedAt x r: x occupies some region
definition: `Located F x := ∃ r, F.locatedAt x r`: x occupies some region. The proposition is that of the rival concreteness criterion SpatiotemporalCriterionConcrete (DEF-CONCRETE-SPATIOTEMPORAL-CRITERION), reused as a property and not as a criterion of concreteness. Occupation is dimensive location; presence by power (ST I q.8 a.3, q.52 a.1) is not represented.
note: Stipulative. SEP 'Abstract Objects' §3.1 (navigation) describes the non-spatiality criterion; the property here is the same proposition with a different role.
